findings.finding: The acceptance conjunction and specified prefix mapping are explicit and independent of fixture-supplied projected values within the finite model.
The revised checker constructs projected value records and typed witness records with context, source, target, and relation provenance; this is supported within the finite fixture model.

The revised checker validates ordered history event payloads and witness identity linkage, but the event schema remains a finite model contract rather than an independently established semantics of history.
Pi_D,C now applies a declared finite prefix mapping, but the mapping is synthetic and does not establish preservation of source relation semantics, injectivity, or reversibility.
The C1 and C2 threshold surfaces pass finite monotonic cases, but threshold values remain supplied model parameters and are not derived or independently measured.
